run_simulation: run a Concordia simulation with entities and game masters using the Simulation class play method
add_entity_to_simulation: add an entity with a prefab config and optional memory state to the simulation
add_game_master_to_simulation: add a game master with a prefab config to the simulation with shared memory bank
save_and_load_checkpoints: save simulation state to a JSON checkpoint file and load it back to resume
set_component_dynamic_state: update a dynamic state variable on an entity component by entity name and key
